requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Getting Started with Memotto"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memotto is a note-taking app that lets you gather text, tables, and images in one place."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide uses examples from Yamanashi in PR and Takanashi in Sales to explain how it works."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "A short note attached to a page is called a \"Quick Note\"."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Ms. Yamanashi records the decisions from meetings in a Quick Note."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Ms. Yamanashi puts a Sticky on important parts as a marker."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You can add up to ten comments per page."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Using it as a team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi's sales team first created a Space."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The place inside a Space that everyone can see is called the \"Commons\" (ひろば)."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post notes to the Commons."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Mr. Takanashi shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite members to a Space by email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "An invitation email will be sent to the invited person."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once an admin approves, they can join right away."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed for each hiroba."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and Revisions"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all of your devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can edit them offline, and they sync as soon as you reconnect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can restore an earlier version of a page from its Revisions."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yamanashi-san recovered a passage she had accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tips for organizing"}, {"id": 1, "text": "It's handy to pin important pages."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes in Hiroba become easier to find when you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Takanashi-san divides her tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The same tag can also be used for a one-line note."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Search finds both 広場 and ひとこと at the same time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "If you can't find what you're looking for, try widening the search scope."}]}

translations.10: The place inside a Space that everyone can see is called the "Commons" (ひろば).

translations.12: Mr. Takanashi shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning.
translations.13: You can invite members to a Space by email.
translations.14: An invitation email will be sent to the invited person.
translations.15: Once an admin approves, they can join right away.
translations.16: Member permissions can also be changed for each hiroba.
translations.18: Notes are saved automatically and synced to all of your devices.
translations.19: You can edit them offline, and they sync as soon as you reconnect.

translations.20: You can restore an earlier version of a page from its Revisions.
translations.21: Yamanashi-san recovered a passage she had accidentally deleted.
translations.23: It's handy to pin important pages.
translations.24: Pinned pages appear at the top of the list.
translations.25: Notes in Hiroba become easier to find when you add tags.
translations.27: Takanashi-san divides her tags by project.
translations.28: The same tag can also be used for a one-line note.
translations.29: Search finds both 広場 and ひとこと at the same time.
